description: This file defines an interface for a streaming producer grain within an Orleans-based distributed application, specifying methods related to producing data streams, managing consumers, and control operations.

classes.name: IStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a streaming producer grain, providing methods to start/stop producing streams, produce data in various modes, retrieve production metrics, manage consumers, and control grain lifecycle.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Initializes the grain to become a producer for a specific stream with a given provider and namespace.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the grain from acting as a producer.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items in order.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a series of items in parallel.

methods.name: GetExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the count of items expected to be produced.

methods.name: GetItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items actually produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain identified by its GUID.

methods.name: GetProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of producer instances.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies that the streaming process has finished, marked with an attribute to allow interleaving execution.
